metadata.title: Roast Yourself
metadata.description: Show a bored critic your Steam library and let them review your taste.

spotify.title: Your Spotify history
spotify.lead: Upload your data export. The file is read in this browser and never reaches the server.
spotify.dropHint: A ZIP file or JSON files with your listening history. Anything else in the export, like payment data, is not even opened.
spotify.disclosure: The file stays in your browser. The stats and the names above go to the server, then through OpenRouter to an AI model provider, with data collection denied. Plays from private sessions are left out. Limit: 3 reviews a day.
spotify.titlesLead: Remove any artists and tracks you would rather not show. They also leave the stats, and others may take their place.

errors.no_history: This file has no listening history. You need a Spotify data export, for example StreamingHistory_music_0.json.
errors.invalid: This file could not be read. Check that it is an undamaged Spotify export.
errors.too_large: This file is too large for the browser. Upload the individual JSON files instead of the whole archive.

guide.title: How to get your export
guide.step1: Open the privacy settings of your Spotify account.
guide.step2: Request your account data (the last year, usually a few days) or the extended history (the whole account, up to 30 days).
guide.step3: Confirm the request in the email from Spotify.
guide.step4: When the data arrives, download the ZIP file and upload it here.

live.connectLead: The quickest way: one click, with no wait for an export. The critic sees your rankings and recent plays, but not your listening hours.
live.connectFailed: We could not connect to Spotify. Please try again.
live.unavailable: Spotify is not responding. Please try again shortly.
live.expired: Your Spotify connection expired. Disconnect and connect again.
live.notAllowed: This app is in test mode and only works for a few listed accounts, and yours is not one of them. You can upload an export below instead.
live.empty: Spotify has no rankings or plays to review for this account yet.
live.disclosure: The server fetches your rankings and last 50 plays from Spotify. The token lasts under an hour, sits encrypted in a cookie and is stored nowhere else. The stats and the names above go through OpenRouter to an AI model provider, with data collection denied. The finished roast stays in your archive. Limit: 3 reviews a day.
